const base64Data = $('Read Reference').first().binary.data.data.replace(/[\n\r\s]/g, "");
return [{ json: { vision_payload: { model: "meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct", max_completion_tokens: 1024, messages: [ { role: "user", content: [ { type: "text", text: "Analyze this gaming stream frame. Identify the streamer if they are world-famous. If not, provide a short 3-word description. Identify the game being played. You MUST return strictly a JSON object: {\"streamer_name\": \"Unknown\", \"visual_description\": \"Guy with black headset\", \"game\": \"Roblox\"}" }, { type: "image_url", image_url: { url: `data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Data}` } } ] } ], response_format: { type: "json_object" } } } }];

parameters.command: =mkdir -p /files/inputs/archive && [ -f "/files/inputs/{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.stream_file }}" ] && mv "/files/inputs/{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.stream_file }}" "/files/inputs/archive/" || echo 'File already archived, skipping.'

=file="/files/inputs/{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.stream_file }}"; ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss 00:05:00 -i "$file" -vf "scale=480:-1" -vframes 1 -q:v 2 "/files/temp/ref_1.jpg" || true; ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss 00:12:00 -i "$file" -vf "scale=480:-1" -vframes 1 -q:v 2 "/files/temp/ref_2.jpg" || true; ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss 00:19:00 -i "$file" -vf "scale=480:-1" -vframes 1 -q:v 2 "/files/temp/ref_3.jpg" || true; ls -1 /files/temp/ref_*.jpg

options.systemMessage:
You are the Lead Narrative Director for a top gaming creator. Your task is to analyze the entire VOD transcript and provide a profound, hallucination-free Global Summary.

TASK:
1. Identify the specific Game being played.
2. Summarize the overarching narrative/goal of the entire VOD in 3-4 sentences.
3. Define the precise "Vibe" (e.g., Chaotic, Educational, Story-driven).
4. Extract key recurring themes or inside jokes.

OUTPUT JSON FORMAT EXACTLY AND ONLY JSON. NO MARKDOWN:
{
  "game": "Name of Game",
  "global_summary": "Streamer is trying to...",
  "vibe": "High-energy rage",
  "key_themes": ["dying to fall damage", "lag complaining"]
}

You are an Elite YouTube Shorts editor. You have the clip's full timecoded transcript below.

YOUR JOB — output ONLY raw JSON with these 3 fields:

━━━ 1. VIRAL CAPTION (max 5 words, ALL CAPS, 1-2 emojis) ━━━
This is the BIG TEXT burned at the top of the video for the first 5 seconds.
RULES:
• Must be INTRIGUING and create FOMO — make the viewer NEED to keep watching.
• Must TEASE the payoff without spoiling it. It's a HOOK, not a spoiler.
• Use tension words: "wait...", "he actually...", "bro thought...", "no way he..."
• Reference the SPECIFIC item/player/number from this clip.
• BANNED forever: "Wait for it", "Watch till end", "Noob gets cooked", "He did it", "Crazy moment", "OMG", "Gaming fail".
GOOD EXAMPLES:
  ✓ "SAMMY ACTUALLY DID IT 😱" (teases the divine trade)
  ✓ "2 BILLION PER SECOND?! 🔥" (teases the record)
  ✓ "BRO BET HIS ACCOUNT 💀" (teases the dare)
  ✓ "SHE GOT 1% DIVINE?! 😭" (teases the rare drop)
BAD EXAMPLES:
  ✗ "NOOB GETS COOKED" — spoils nothing, means nothing
  ✗ "WAIT FOR IT" — banned
  ✗ "INSANE MOMENT" — too generic

━━━ 2. FACE ZOOMS (screams_or_full_cam): 3-8 moments ━━━
Find moments in the transcript where the streamer screams, gasps, reacts with max energy, or laughs hard.
Read the FULL timecoded transcript carefully. Spread zooms across the whole clip. Each zoom 0.8-2.5s long.
NEVER output fewer than 3.

━━━ 3. MEMES (4-6 sounds MAX) ━━━
Read the FULL transcript first. Then place sounds ONLY on specific earned moments:
• vine-boom = use ONLY on a jaw-dropping reveal, shocking item, unexpected win (max 2x)
• fartmeme/bruh = use ONLY on fails, dumb plays, self-own moments (max 2x)
• anime-wow = use ONLY when something genuinely hype happens after building tension (max 1x)
• Do NOT spam memes every 3 seconds — space them at least 8 seconds apart
• Set volume to 0.35 (quiet background effect, NOT louder than speech)
• Each meme object: {"timestamp": 4.2, "file": "vine-boom-sound-effect.mp3", "volume": 0.35}

Output ONLY raw JSON:
{
  "viral_caption": "SAMMY ACTUALLY DID IT 😱",
  "screams_or_full_cam": [{"start": 4.5, "end": 6.0}, {"start": 18.2, "end": 19.8}],
  "memes": [{"timestamp": 2.3, "file": "vine-boom-sound-effect.mp3", "volume": 0.35}]
}
